You may want to replace the banner image for the Emerging Talent page (https://realtorcareers-dev.ttcportals.com/pages/emerging-talent), as it doesn't have proper accessibility coloring for the text, i.e., the background color with black or white text does not have enough contrast. 

I recommend an image closely resembling the banner images of the Who We Are or How We Hire pages.
